normalization: Fixture-root absolute paths become <fixture>. Internal resource identity dev/ino become <fixture-dev>/<fixture-ino>, as independent temporary fixtures cannot share inode identity. Map/Set are represented as ordered entries/values. Public results are compared in complete JSON semantics, where undefined fields/functions are omitted as with JSON output. prepare-full and candidate-partial-layout compare only their serializable data projections, not object methods/private state. No diagnostics, warnings, source, facets, coverage or relations are removed. Every counted pair is deep-compared before successful pairs are replaced by canonical SHA-256 and byte counts.
counting: Synchronous function-entry and primitive Proxy counters only; no async coverage. query*InputElements are processed element counts, not comparator calls. Counter timings are discarded. Fixture construction is outside each timed operation. markdownReads counts fs.readFile only, excluding FileHandle.read used by content matching.
timing: Independent Node processes, no --import hook, empty NODE_OPTIONS, alternating variant order. Timers enclose only the actual operation, excluding fixture setup, result normalization/serialization and cleanup. Warm in-process module/OS filesystem state is shared only across named operations within one sample process; no explicit warmup. Equivalence is checked in counted pairs, not repeated timing processes; production source manifests are verified stable across the complete run. Wall-clock samples are descriptive, not CPU claims.
